spans.text: Unit 7: Be a data architect
In order to ensure that the data is represented correctly in each field we need to describe the fields by:
giving each field a meaningful name using describing words
setting the data type of each field.
Keyword
attribute: features or characteristics
These are called attributes or characteristics of the field.
Let’s determine the attributes of the fields by stating the field name and data type of each field.
Data items will be stored under the appropriate fields. The field name should be meaningful, describing what data will be stored. The field names should not be too long.
Data item | Field name
Code for each club | Club Code
Name of the club | Club Name
Date to register for the club | Registration Date
Total number of members allowed in each club | Number of members
Once we have determined the field names, we can add the data types. Some of the data types that can be used in a database are Number, Text, Currency, Date/Time.
Data item | Field name | Data type | Reason for choosing each data type
Code for each club (e.g. BO101) | Club Code | Text | Club code is a combination of numbers and letters. It will not be used in a calculation.
Name of the club (e.g. Book) | Club Name | Text | Club name is a string of letters and will not be used in a calculation.
Date to register for the club (e.g. 14/9/2022) | Registration Date | Date | Registration Date – a date is required.
Total number of members allowed in each club (e.g. 15) | Number of members | Number | Number of members – numbers are needed and they can be used in a calculations.
Now we have set up the table so we can enter the data. The table with data added should look like this:
5 records (rows)
4 fields (columns)
Club Code | Club Name | Registration Date | Number of members
RO001 | Robotics beginners | 15/9/2022 | 30
RO002 | Robotics advanced | 16/9/2022 | 35

There can be more than one record with the same data item, such as two people with the same name. In these cases, it becomes difficult for the database to retrieve the correct record without a field that uniquely identifies it. This is why a Club Code was included. The Club Code uniquely identifies each club.
